# Example: List with Circle Bullets

#### Course: Learn CSS

## Example: List with Circle Bullets

You can also use other bullet styles like circle or disc.

Here's how you can do that:

```html
1<ul class="circle">
2    <li>Apple</li>
3    <li>Ball</li>
4    <li>Cat</li>
5</ul>
```

```css
1ul.circle {
2    list-style-type: circle;    /* Adds circle bullets */
3}
```

Browser Output

![HTML List with Circle Bullets](data:image/png;base64,)

Now, the list items have circle bullets.

Replace the circle with a disc in the above code. The list will then have disc bullets.
